column1: Contact: Matt Kimura#5610  Add me on Discord and message me for any concerns or to submit saves. I love talking about emulation!

When I first discovered a save for Resident Evil 2 with everything unlocked, I realized how useful saves are. So I thought to myself: why not create a spreadsheet and share these saves with everyone, similar to my list of improvement hacks. It can be a real hassle finding saves since most of the time the saves are in other formats that emulators can't use. In some cases, hex editing is required to convert those saves. I want to provide saves that you can easily use with emulators without jumping through hoops. Some of these saves are essential to making games much more enjoyable. A lot of us don't have the time these days to sit down and unlock everything from scratch. Some game unlocks are hardcore or no longer possible. Or you may have completed a game in the past but no longer have that save anymore. That's where these saves come into play and help you reach all the content of a game. There's many reasons to use these saves, it all depends on the user's needs. This list doesn't aim to include every game out there, so it's a take what you can get kind of deal. But I hope what I have here is useful to everyone! There will be different types of saves offered here such as 100%, starter, etc.

If you want to give feedback about any saves or submit save files, use this form:
https://forms.gle/NjwDmSWf5JbxSKUy9

If you enjoy this list, also check out my list of improvement rom hacks:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dvVDYdju7NNjqwAR9o9FP4X2cAxnDzuPefNPfXq7V7Y/edit?usp=sharing
